newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices fall, volume up slightly.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices fall, volume up slightly.

text.p: Prices on the Istanbul gold exchange fell further on Thursday in line with European trends and volume rose slightly but was still at fairly low levels as dealers waited for world markets to stabilise.
Gold closed at $368.30 an ounce, down from $370.60 on Wednesday and at 1,231,800 lira per gram versus 1,234,000.
Volume crept up to 360 kilos from the previous 270 kilos.
The morning session saw 325 kilos traded with just 35 kilos in the afternoon. 54.2 percent of the total turnover was in dollar terms. --Istanbul newsroom +90-212-275 08 75
